ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, estimated at approximately 15:85.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing boundary; specifically, multiple small-amplitude 'saw-tooth' peaks along the right lobe and more rounded, low-frequency oscillations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve characterized by proximal concavity near the median notch transitioning to distal convexity at the outer lobe edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-parallel white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible across both lobes, with higher density and greater longitudinal length on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the outer distal edges of both lobes; significant linear scarring across the dark pigmentation of the fluke surface.
